name: Scientific compute (untrusted Python script)
description: Runs ONE customer-supplied Python script (numpy, scipy, pandas) as UNTRUSTED code inside the hardened container: no network, wall-clock cap, memory and output caps. Output files are collected. Exact-hash verification applies only when params.deterministic is true. See kits/scientific-compute/README.md.

verification.owner_decision: OWNER DECISION: byte-for-byte comparison of results and logs against an independent re-run, applied only when the re-run's logs/determinism.json says deterministic=true (params.deterministic); otherwise the outcome is inconclusive, never a failure of the host. Determinism is only as good as the customer's script (threads, hash order, time, randomness): the kit pins seeds and thread counts but cannot prove a script is reproducible. Sample fraction also pending owner approval.
